Description
Specifications include, but are not limited to: This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors. The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP.

Bid Summary.value: The RFP seeks student and staff computing devices—including laptops, desktops, tablets, and display monitors—and allows vendors to submit proposals for any or all categories, with the District able to award contracts to one or multiple vendors. Minimum hardware tiers are defined, such as Tier 1 Small Student Chromebook laptops requiring 64 GB eMMC storage, a Chrome OS license and a 1‑year warranty; Tier 2 Large Student Chromebooks requiring 128 GB eMMC, 8 GB DDR5 memory, Wi‑Fi 6E, and a 1‑year warranty; and Tier 3 Student Windows laptops requiring Autopilot‑ready management, an Intel i5 13th‑Gen processor, and Windows 11 Pro. Staff device tiers include Tier 1 Staff Windows Basic Desktops with an Intel i5 14th‑Gen processor, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB NVMe SSD, Windows 11 Pro and a 3‑year warranty; Tier 2 Staff Professional Desktops with an Intel i7 14th‑Gen processor, 32 GB DDR5 RAM, 1 TB NVMe SSD, and either Windows 11 Pro or macOS, also with a 3‑year warranty. Tier 2 Staff Laptops must be enterprise‑management ready, feature an Intel i7 14th‑Gen CPU, 32 GB DDR5 RAM, 1 TB NVMe SSD, Windows 11 or macOS, and a 3‑year warranty. The RFP also specifies a Student Tablet with an A13 processor, 10.2‑inch Retina display, iOS 17, 64 GB storage and a 1‑year warranty, and display monitors (both touch and non‑touch) with a minimum 24‑inch screen, 1920 × 1080 resolution, USB 3.1 hub and a 3‑year warranty.

{"headers": [], "rows": [["PURPOSE OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)
This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops,
desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors participating in this Request for Proposal (RFP) may
submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. Within each category
of device, the District reserves the right to award contracts to a single vendor or multiple vendors.
The specifications listed in this RFP are the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device required
by Dallas ISD. Vendors responding to this RFP must have the ability to provide the District with significant
quantities of devices as requested in the pricing lines in this RFP. Note that quantities requested by Dallas
ISD are estimates to be ordered over the five years of the contracts resulting from this RFP. Purchases may
also include a variety of device accessories which will be ordered in a bundle along with the devices. Such
accessories include, but are not limited to, sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables that may not
necessarily come with the devices.
Each submission must include a detailed plan as to how the vendor will track all shipped products and
provide deployment services. Processes and procedures are required in the response, which outlines how
tracking will be executed and any processes for providing white glove services.
The awarded vendors shall provide Dallas ISD with computing devices that meet all current industry
standard specifications. The awarded vendors and Dallas ISD EdTech-Enterprise Support Services shall
meet every six months or as needed to discuss technology advancements related to computing devices to
be selected by Dallas ISD.
Note: For each purchase during the term of the contracts resulting from this RFP, the District will seek
competitive quotes from one or more of the awarded vendors.", null]]}
